notes.title: Profile and Stats Overhaul
notes.content:
Hey Keymasters,

Since the last patch we have been tracking and working on the issues we see from feedback, and some features that were lacking some love. The Profile section was not fully hooked up for a while, and some of the UI was old and needed to be re-envisioned. We updated that section, got the stats working, added Role XP and basic function and even got more card and ability fixes in there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636933/683ced01069f9eef2409c3ae42e699e46c9420c8.png

Now the Profile Tab shows Leader types played, Origins played, which has the most wins, and then your current Rank and XP as the Roles you select. Right now the Strategist is checking KP gained, Brute is checking damage dealt, and Joker is tracking healing of enemies and damage of random targets or your own. What we track for the role XP will also grow over time so stay tuned for those changes.

Here is a full list of the changes and bug fixes:

Patch 34 Notes:

- Profile and Stats Overhaul
- More Stats and Achievements Implemented
- Roles XP In
- More Crash Fixes
- Bots Attacking Traps Fixed
- Spells No Longer Break when Clicked
- Random Chance applied separately to targets now
- Kabukamanodon Fixed
- Ancient Technology Fixed
- Mending Magic Fixed
- Fungal Spore Fixed

Thanks for checking out this update, and stayed tuned for an announcement of the next features coming to Dark Table CCG soon!

Kyle @Doonamai

notes.title: New VFX and Screen Shake
notes.content:
Hey Keymasters!

As we patch, and make fixes, we also try to address as many UI/UX issues you bring up as we go. This patch has a bunch of additions for VFX that help with status effects and impact of damage.

Bind, Poison, Rally Cry, Focus, Confuse, Scholar, and more get new VFX to help show status and when traits trigger. Those effects stay on the card until they are removed by phases or other abilities.

Damage now gives some screen shake to help with impact. Card hits and Leader hits have different levels of shake. We will be extending this to be damage based soon so the impact get's crazy for bigger damage.

Patch 33 Notes:

 New VFX
 Screen shake on hits
 Tutorial Fixes
 Bug fixes for Walls and Traps
 Skill Coin Fixes
 Turn timer fixes


Enjoy these new changes and let us know if you have any more suggestions! All your feedback definitely helps us improve the game rapidly. 

See you at the Table.

Kyle @Doonamai

notes.title: Guided Tutorials Added
notes.content:
You asked for Guided Tutorials, and we delivered. This is just a first cut mind you, but it is much easier to follow than the previous video tutorials. Let us know if you have any comments on it and we can make updates as we go.

We also brought some fixes for Bots and Bot games. There were some issues where bots would draw out their entire deck and not fully die. Or when they died it might skip turn. Those are all fixed.

Another major update is that we fixed more potential crashes and may have finally stopped the fatal errors. Please let us know if you see any, and PrintScreen on your keyboard if you can. It will produce a Crash Log for us. Please post it to our Discord in the Bugs section.

Patch 30 Notes:
- Guided Tutorials (version 1)
- Skill Coins Fixed
- Bind and Confuse Traits Fixed
- Additional Crash Fixes
- Bot Death Skip Turn Fix
- Bot Not Fully Dead Fixed
- Host can leave bot-only games

Thanks for playing and we hope you are enjoying these updates! As always, we will see you at the Table... the Dark one...

Kyle @Doonamai

notes.title: Crash Fixes! And other Huge Performance Improvements
notes.content:
Hey Keymasters!

Thanks for all the awesome feedback, we have been working hard over the past 2 weeks to address the largest issues first to get a smoother game experience, and you should enjoy this latest patch.

Patch 24 Notes:

- Fixed Game Start Crashes (In-Game)
- Improved Game Level Loading Times Drastically (Reduced from about 1.5 minutes down to 10 seconds)
- Improved Performance (Less RAM and GPU)
- Improved Season Pass Tab (Hover over enlarge icons)
- Adjusted UI on Profile Tab
- Reduced Amount of objects loaded in level
- Reduced network traffic
- Made game startup more reliable
- Improved Matchmaking function (Waits less for additional players)
- Added more robust error checking to prevent crashes
- Progress bar on matchmaking (to see when the matchmaker will stop waiting for more players and go)
- Improved the Achievement notifications
- Steam Display Name now shown in-game
- Fixed a Matchmaking Crash
- Adjusted Beginning Currency to let players experiment with decks faster.

We heard what you were saying so we adjusted starting currency on accounts to allow players to get started with deckbuilding faster. You may have to play a few games to get enough currency to build exactly what you want.

Also be aware that the Season Pass has a free track on top, so you earn those items and currencies just from playing games and leveling up.

Thanks for checking out this Patch update, and please leave us comments if you have further suggestions. We expect to bring more players in now that the game is more reliable, and that will make it easier to find games with players. You can still always play with friends by directly inviting them to custom games as well, just swap the Mode to custom by pressing the Mode button next to Queue.

We hope to see you in there!

Thanks,
Kyle @Doonamai

notes.title: Performance and 1v1 Update!
notes.content:
Hey Keymasters!

Thanks for all the great feedback everyone, and also thanks to those that jumped in the discord server to chat. We have heard the suggestions and are actively working fixes for everyone. Based on the comments, here were the major issues people want fixed:

- Performance overall (Ram and GPU usage were high)
- Peer to Peer being an issue for Hosts leaving
- Matchmaking time being annoying because players were resetting the wait timer
- Crashes (on Startup and In-Game)
- No interactive tutorial

Patch 23 addresses a lot of the first 4 issues:

- Cut memory usage by roughly 80%
- Cut GPU usage by roughly 80%
- Fixed UI scaling issue on Game Level
- Improved game performance and load times
- Fixed lobby timers to not restart when someone joins
- Added 1v1 mode to Solo Queue so you don't have to worry about host leaving (Working Dedicated Servers soon to fix altogether) *Keep in mind the cards are not balanced for 1v1, they are meant for 3-4 players*

This update should help those that were crashing with Ram and GPU memory issues. It should also provide better matchmaking timers, plus 1v1 mode means that the host doesn't need to stay after the game is over (until we fix altogether with dedicated servers.

For the in-game crashes we have hired a quality team to help track those down so we can fix those, so stand by on that front. We will try to address these in a timely manner.

For interactive tutorials and dedicated servers, we have those on the list to tackle after the crashes are cleared. More info on that soon.

Thanks for following along and for playing! Drop in the Discord if you haven't already, and come chat with us. We love the feedback and want to grow this game with you.

Thanks,
Kyle @Doonamai
